context_requirements: Functional HRH1-mediated histamine signaling, which is absent or minimal in these nine cancer cell lines under standard culture conditions
An inflammatory or allergic microenvironment providing histamine or H1R autoinduction, not present in this assay
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines at 10 micromolar that is not explained by off-target cytotoxicity
Upregulation of HRH1 or histamine-responsive genes (e.g., NFKBIA, CCL2, IL1B) after treatment

evidence.supports: Antihistamines suppress histamine-induced H1R mRNA upregulation in nasal mucosa, indicating HRH1-dependent transcriptional effects require an allergic/inflammatory context
H1-antihistamine fexofenadine had no or little effect on detergent-induced dermatitis gene expression, showing weak transcriptional impact of H1 blockade alone
Ebastine inhibits cancer growth by targeting EZH2 at concentrations below 10 micromolar, an off-target effect distinct from HRH1 blockade
Ketotifen shows anti-fibrotic effects in a rabbit model, but these are mast-cell-stabilizer effects rather than direct HRH1-mediated transcription
